chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Make up the prayer of the day at whatever hour you wish, from the night or the day; all of that is the same.

key_terms.النَّهَارِ: The daytime, indicating the original period of the missed prayer
key_terms.اِقْضِ: Perform the make-up of a missed act of worship
key_terms.سَوَاءٌ: Equal, meaning there is no difference between those times for this make-up
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: The prayer being referred to for make-up
key_terms.لَيْلٍ: The night, showing permissibility of making it up then
key_terms.نَهَارٍ: The day, also showing permissibility of making it up then

ai.seo_question: When can missed daytime nawafil be made up according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that missed daytime supererogatory prayers may be made up at any time, whether during the night or the day. It indicates flexibility in the time of qaḍāʾ for these nawafil and that these times are equal in this regard.
